      FI’s Warning List

      Finansinspektionen issues warnings about “firms” that do not have authorisation but offer financial services or products.

      The International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO) has a database that includes all of the warnings issued by countries around the world, including those from Finansinspektionen: I-SCAN

      Check if the company has received authorisation in our Companies Register.
